subtitle: Amapuzzle okulandelana
short_description: Gcwalisa igridi ye-4×4 lapho izimpawu zikhomba khona abakhelene abalandelanayo.
description:
Gcwalisa igridi ye-4×4 ngamadijithi angu-1 kuya ku-4 ukuze idijithi ngayinye ivele kanye emugqeni ngamunye nakukholomu ngayinye. Umphetho omakiwe phakathi kwamasikwele amabili usho ukuthi amadijithi awo ayalandelana; umphetho ongamakiwe usho ukuthi awalandelani.

Khetha isikwele bese uthayipha idijithi kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-4. Imicibisholo ekhona ngaphakathi kwamasikwele ikhomba imiphetho emakiwe ngakwesokudla nangaphansi.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
